title: Arc bundles on a dashed globe

reference.grammar: bundles of thin gradient arcs from a hub on black; dashed meridians of a sphere; small square nodes with numeric labels; soft glow

techniques.name: Dashed meridians
techniques.limits: Over ~31 meridians the dashes of neighbors align into bands. A radius under the half-height of the sheet shows the sphere outline and the picture reads as a ball, not a field.
techniques.implementation: Each meridian is an ellipse with the sphere radius as its tall axis and radius·|sin λ| as its wide one, stroked with a 6 on 5 dash.

techniques.name: Nested arc bundle

fan_u.note: length of the line the strokes end along

stagger.note: share of the reach by which stroke ends step back across the bundle

params.curve: quadratic; control point at mid-chord, pushed sideways by bend × chord length

techniques.limits: fan under ~10 u collapses a bundle to one thick line. Past ~24 bundles the sheet fills and single arcs stop reading.
techniques.implementation: For each bundle a target point is picked around the hub; stroke ends are spaced along a line through it, and each stroke is a quadratic curve whose sideways bend steps up across the bundle.

techniques.name: Along-stroke gradient

params.ink_step: ink index steps across the bundle, mixed with the next ink

techniques.limits: With both alphas at 1 on a dark ground, crossings near the hub clip to white.
techniques.implementation: A linear gradient from the hub to the stroke end colors each stroke: faint at the root, full ink at the tip. Strokes are composited with the lighter blend.

techniques.name: Additive glow
techniques.limits: gain above ~1 washes the thin strokes into a haze.
techniques.implementation: The stroke layer is blurred and added back over itself.

techniques.name: Numbered nodes
techniques.limits: Over ~60 nodes the labels overlap. Type under 9 u is unreadable at 900 px.
techniques.implementation: Square markers sit on bundle ends and on seeded free points; each carries a seeded number set up and to the right.

pass_order: grid · dashed meridians, one solid axis
arcs · bundles from the hub, gradient strokes, lighter blend
notes: Measured on ref.png: stroke ≈ 0.9 px at 702 px (1.25 u); dash ≈ 4 px on, 3.5 px off; label cap height ≈ 7.5 px.
The numbers are generated and stand for nothing. The subject is new: hub, bundle directions and node positions differ from the reference.
